verses.pali: “Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, acinteyyāni, na cintetabbāni; yāni cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four things are unthinkable. They should not be thought about, and anyone who tries to think about them will go mad or get frustrated.

verses.pali: Buddhānaṁ, bhikkhave, buddhavisayo acinteyyo, na cintetabbo;
yaṁ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
Jhāyissa, bhikkhave, jhānavisayo acinteyyo, na cintetabbo;
verses.english: The domain of one in absorption …

verses.pali: yaṁ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
yaṁ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
yaṁ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri acinteyyāni, na cintetabbāni; yāni cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assā”ti.
verses.english: These are the four unthinkable things. They should not be thought about, and anyone who tries to think about them will go mad or get frustrated.”
